turns.userText:
Build an offline BGP relationship inference and route leak scoring service.
Work in `/workspace`; Python 3.11 and its standard library are available.
Read `PROTOCOL.md` for the complete model, schemas

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat instruction.md && cat PARTITION.md && cat public_check.py && find examples -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%f %s\n' | sort && find submission

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && for f in examples/*.json; do echo ===$f; cat "$f"; echo; done && echo ===starter && cat submission/main.py

ServiceUnavailableError: HTTP 503 litellm.ServiceUnavailableError: ServiceUnavailableError: OpenAIException - An error occurred in model serving, error message is: [Decode endpoint generation retired: generation=174098] (request retried)

records.name: bash
records.summary: cp /workspace/tmp/test_inference.py /workspace/tmp/t2.py && sed -i '/for trial in range(20):/a\    print("trial",trial, flush=True)' /workspace/tmp/t2.py && tim

records.name: bash
records.summary: cat /proc/loadavg; for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do if [ -r "$d/cmdline" ]; then c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "$d/cmdline"); case "$c" in *test_inference*|*t2.py*) echo "$d $c";;

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/random.randint(0,1000000)/random.randint(0,2000000000)/' tmp/bench_ve.py && time python3 tmp/bench_ve.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && printf '%s' '{"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[],"priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[],"queries":[]}' | python3 -I submission/main.py; echo; printf

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la submission && stat -c '%F %s %h' submission/main.py && find submission -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%y %f %s\n'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/range(512)/range(10)/' tmp/bench_full.py && time timeout 60 python3 -u tmp/bench_full.py; echo rc=$?

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && timeout 60 python3 -m cProfile -s cumulative tmp/debug_bench.py > /tmp/prof.txt 2>&1; tail -50 /tmp/prof.txt

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/range(10)/range(512)/' tmp/bench_full.py && time timeout 120 python3 -u tmp/bench_full.py; echo rc=$?

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && time python3 -u tmp/test_full.py && time python3 -u tmp/test_inference.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && stat -c '%s %h %F' submission/main.py && tail -5 submission/main.py && python3 -m py_compile submission/main.py && echo compiled

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed 's/if valid>=300: break/if valid>=1000: break/' tmp/test_full.py > tmp/test_full1000.py && time python3 -u tmp/test_full1000.py

records.summary: cd /workspace && find submission -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %p %s %n\n' && python3 public_check.py && find submission -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %p %s %n\n'
